newsitem.title: POLAND: BPH CONVERTIBLE BOND ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED.
newsitem.headline: BPH CONVERTIBLE BOND ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED.

text.p: Polish Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy's $100-million convertible five-year eurobond issue was oversubscribed, the bank's president said on Thursday.
Henryka Pieronkiewicz told a news conference the bonds, which were offered in London at a par value of $1,000, would start trade on the London exchange on Friday.

"There were orders for $330 million worth bonds of the $100 million offered, which gave the issuer and the lead manager a possibility of selecting investors and setting good issue conditions," she said.
She said the bond yield was at 6.23 percent, 35 basis points below five-year U.S. treasury bonds. She declined to say who or how many investors took the bonds.
Pieronkiewicz said the bonds carry a coupon of three percent and will be exchangeable for 17,037 shares each.
Pieronkiewicz said she hoped all the bonds would be exchanged into shares.
"We are sure the whole issue would be converted, the conditions of the issue let us think so," she said.
